prompt: You have to give a five-minute class presentation in ten days. Which rehearsal plan makes best use of spacing?

options.text: Rehearse once for two hours on the night before
Read the slides silently every day without ever speaking them aloud
Practise speaking it aloud for about 15 minutes on four separate days, improving one part each time
Memorise the whole script word for word in one long session

explanation: Short practice sessions spread over several days are remembered better than the same time crammed into one session, and speaking aloud practises the actual skill you will need.
